name: Whitesburg Electronics Inc
old_description: Founded by Wayne Jacks in 1977, Whitesburg Electronics. manufactures high-quality electronics and electro-mechanical assemblies and provides solutions for government, industry, and commercial clients.
about:
Whitesburg Electronics Inc was founded in 1977 by Wayne Jacks in Lacey's Spring, Alabama. The company remains family-owned, with Jacks serving as owner and CEO and his daughter June B. Jacks as vice president.

The company manufactures printed circuit board assemblies, wiring harnesses, cable assemblies, and full electro-mechanical assemblies from a 32,500-square-foot facility equipped with Juki surface-mount placement machines. Its capabilities span through-hole and fine-pitch SMT (down to 5 mm), manual and machine high-reliability soldering, conformal coating, potting, chassis wiring, and high-volume packaging. Whitesburg handles production runs from medium to large scale, supported by a workforce with over 500 collective years of experience.

Whitesburg serves government, industrial, and commercial clients. Its customer base includes Fortune 500 firms such as IBM, Caterpillar, Teledyne Brown Engineering, and Boeing, as well as federal agencies like NASA and the Department of Defense, alongside smaller businesses with specialized requirements.

The company emphasizes zero-defect delivery on schedule, backed by a quality system that includes MIL-STD-45208 inspection, ISO/IEC 17025 calibration, IPC-J-STD-001 and IPC-A-610 soldering and assembly standards, and a CFC-free, EPA-compliant cleaning process. Whitesburg also highlights its ability to handle confidential customer requirements and military specifications.
